pred_sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.state FROM Owners o JOIN Professionals p ON o.state = p.state
SELECT d.name FROM Dogs d JOIN Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id GROUP BY d.dog_id, d.name HAVING SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) <= 1000
SELECT b.breed_name FROM Dogs d JOIN Breeds b ON d.breed_code = b.breed_code GROUP BY b.breed_code, b.breed_name ORDER BY COUNT(d.dog_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT email_address FROM Professionals WHERE state = 'Hawaii' OR state = 'Wisconsin'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.dog_id) FROM Dogs AS T1 INNER JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id
SELECT cost_of_treatment FROM Treatments ORDER BY date_of_treatment DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name, age, weight FROM Dogs WHERE abandoned_yn = '1'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses

SELECT d.department_name, d.department_id FROM Departments d JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON d.department_id = dp.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name ORDER BY COUNT(dp.degree_program_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.semester_name, s.semester_id FROM Student_Enrolment se JOIN Semesters s ON se.semester_id = s.semester_id GROUP BY s.semester_id, s.semester_name ORDER BY COUNT(se.student_enrolment_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.semester_name FROM Semesters s LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON s.semester_id = se.semester_id WHERE se.student_enrolment_id IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT s.last_name FROM Students s JOIN Addresses a ON s.current_address_id = a.address_id LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON s.student_id = se.student_id WHERE a.state_province_county = 'North Carolina' AND se.student_enrolment_id IS NULL
SELECT first_name FROM Students WHERE permanent_address_id != current_address_id

SELECT DISTINCT s.semester_id FROM Semesters s JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON s.semester_id = se.semester_id JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON se.degree_program_id = dp.degree_program_id WHERE dp.degree_summary_name IN ('Master', 'Bachelor') GROUP BY s.semester_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dp.degree_summary_name) = 2
SELECT first_name, birth_date FROM players WHERE country_code = 'USA'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) FROM players
SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE year = 2013 INTERSECT SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE year = 2016

SELECT DISTINCT p.country_code, p.first_name FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE m.tourney_name IN ('WTA Championships', 'Australian Open') GROUP BY p.player_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.tourney_name) = 2
SELECT year FROM matches GROUP BY year ORDER BY COUNT(match_num) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT country_code FROM players GROUP BY country_code HAVING COUNT(player_id) > 50

SELECT name FROM Dogs WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', date_arrived) = '2018-03' OR strftime('%Y-%m', date_adopted) = '2018-03' OR strftime('%Y-%m', date_departed) = '2018-03' OR strftime('%Y-%m', date_of_birth) = '2018-03'
SELECT COUNT(dog_id) FROM Dogs WHERE strftime('%Y', date_arrived) = '2017' OR strftime('%Y', date_adopted) = '2017' OR strftime('%Y', date_departed) = '2017'
SELECT first_name FROM Students WHERE strftime('%Y', date_first_registered) = '2014' OR strftime('%Y', date_left) = '2014'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Students WHERE strftime('%Y', date_first_registered) = '1975' OR strftime('%Y', date_left) = '1975'
SELECT DISTINCT tourney_date FROM matches WHERE year = 2016
SELECT first_name FROM Owners UNION SELECT first_name FROM Professionals
SELECT o.home_phone, o.cell_number, p.home_phone, p.cell_number FROM Owners o CROSS JOIN Professionals p
SELECT T1.first_name, T2.line_1 FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id = T2.address_id
SELECT course_description FROM Courses
SELECT winner_name, loser_name FROM matches WHERE round = 'Final'
SELECT SUM(charge_amount) FROM Charges
SELECT SUM(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments
SELECT COUNT(current_address_id) FROM Students WHERE current_address_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(ranking_points) FROM rankings
SELECT COUNT(match_num) FROM matches WHERE year = 2016
SELECT MIN(ranking) FROM rankings
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, r.ranking_points FROM players p JOIN rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id ORDER BY r.ranking_points DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT dog_id FROM Dogs ORDER BY date_arrived DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name FROM Students ORDER BY date_first_registered DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(tourney_date) FROM matches
